priority_decision.rationale: The909 reviewed pending packages already cover most familiar body, household and school heads. Distinct useful gaps remain in body vocabulary, household heat/utensils and concrete school/play/nature observations. Forty root-authored hypotheses are selected after exact canonical and legacy hold checks, with no duplicate accepted broad senses or extra qualifiers selected only for count. They are not cleared paradigms or installable items.
priority_decision.backlog_extension: Bounded root-authored everyday/school/home/nature hypotheses extend the historical backlog. Cached frequency supports familiarity only; no exhaustion claim.
priority_decision.existing_stock_priority: The 62-family/101-key matching-lemma morphology lane and preserved10-family/19-key scope remain the narrower prospective curation/integration decision. No accepted family is re-researched or installed by this selection.
